note:
HAPPY BIRTHDAY, SRI! 

Genuinely cannot believe you’re 17 now. Dancing queen indeed, possibly the best to have ever existed — though I think ABBA severely underestimated how intelligent and powerful and SALAY a seventeen-year-old girl could actually be, especially when they are YOU. You are one of the most amazing people I know — so intelligent, perceptive, talented ( how are you good at so many things? It's unfair), fiercely opinionated (always rightfully so), and full of the presence that brightens the atmosphere of a room the second you walk in it. We might be fickle, stupid beings with poor memories and a spectacular gift for self-destruction, but I’m so glad that I get to exist in the same timeline as you. 

Thank you for every conversation, every laugh, every high discussion, every moment where you’ve made life feel infinitely more bearable just by being in it. I love you and miss you so much, and you deserve the world, the galaxy, and the stars beyond it — and I hope 17 brings a part of that in the form of an amazing day and year for you <33
